text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> brilliantly surpassed Sonnet Elfie in 
total points and advanced to the Finals 
with the top score in the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Alongside Sonnet Elfie, who also advanced 
to the finals, she was viewed by the 
public as the foremost favorite to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Firing up their fighting spirit toward the 
championship tournament, they forge ahead!
